$comment: Owner-merge paths (docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md §23.1, D50, D61, D81, D82). A pull request that touches one changes the pipeline, code a privileged job runs, or what every later agent obeys: owner-merge.yml labels it owner-merge and turns its auto-merge off, change detection never calls it docs-only, and Dependabot's auto-merge refuses it. The owner merges it after reading the diff, or the session acting for the owner does by D81's rule: every check green on its exact head SHA, two independent security reviews of the full diff of every owner-merge path it changes, and no REFUSE left unresolved. A `**` segment stands for any number of directories, none included: `dir/**` is everything under dir, `**/CLAUDE.md` is a CLAUDE.md at any depth, the root included, and other entries are exact files. Matched after NFKC normalization and without case, as macOS reads names (D82). Always read from the base branch. `branches` is the release PR's branch (scripts/delivery/lib/release-branch.mjs).
